evidence_note: The motivational case is condensed from the upstream complete example. The educational and commercial cases use sources published in upstream tests/scenarios/application-cases.md and are Project 008 simulations of the public contracts, not official upstream runs or rendered videos.

cases.title: Stop Letting Overthinking Ruin Your Life
cases.source: 你是不是也经常这样？明明什么都还没做，但感觉自己已经累坏了。还没迈出第一步，你的脑子里就已经提前演练了一百种失败的结局。别让想太多毁掉你的生活。
cases.evidence: upstream complete example, condensed for the research UI

scenes.vo: Do you ever feel exhausted before you have even begun? Nothing has happened yet, but your mind is already carrying a hundred imaginary disasters.
beats: A lonely figure notices one violet thought dot
The dot multiplies into a clock, draining battery, and rotating tangle
The tangle expands until it fills the frame
scenes.first_frame: A stands alone with lowered shoulders
scenes.final_frame: violet thought lines fill the frame
scenes.audio: restrained piano, clock tick, electrical pulse, low rumble

scenes.vo: Before the first step, you picture failure, judgment, rejection, and every possible way things could go wrong. Your thoughts turn possibilities into prisons.
beats: The camera flies through the inherited violet tangle
Failure, judgment, and rejection appear as icon-only fear scenes
The scenes flatten into a red prison
scenes.first_frame: inside the same rotating violet tangle
scenes.audio: wind, fall impact, nonverbal whispers, stamp hits, metal slam

scenes.vo: Then come the questions: What if I fail? What will people think? The more you search for certainty, the tighter fear wraps around your feet.
beats: Inherited prison bars become vines around the ankles
A treadmill moves backward while doubt spirals multiply
A gold beam cuts through the spiral tunnel
scenes.first_frame: red bars descend from the previous scene
scenes.final_frame: a gold beam spans the full frame
scenes.audio: heartbeat, vine creaks, treadmill friction, clean cutting sound

scenes.vo: But reality is rarely what hurts you most. It is the future your mind keeps inventing. Action does not require confidence; confidence follows action.
beats: The inherited beam bends into a road
A second figure trips, reconstructs, and keeps running
Imaginary disaster frames shatter behind the first figure
scenes.first_frame: the gold beam crosses the entire frame
scenes.final_frame: one glass fragment fills the lens
scenes.audio: warming piano, footsteps, reconstruction clicks, glass break

scenes.vo: So interrupt the loop. Choose one tiny move and do it now. Send the message, open the document, take the first imperfect step.
beats: The inherited fragment exits to reveal hands gripping vines
Gold energy breaks the restraint
Icon-only send, document, and path actions end on a raised foot
scenes.first_frame: the same glass fragment covers the frame
scenes.final_frame: the right foot pauses before landing
scenes.audio: uplifting beat, energy charge, vine snap, send tone, keyboard taps

scenes.vo: The moment you move, fear loses power. Stop waiting to feel ready. Try, make mistakes, grow—and prove your thoughts do not control your life.
beats: The inherited foot lands and releases a gold shockwave
The floor folds into a rising mountain path
The figure climbs toward a gold horizon and clean CTA space
scenes.first_frame: the raised right foot matches the previous position
scenes.final_frame: gold path and clean negative space hold for the edit
scenes.audio: strong drums, energy wave, folding motion, climbing steps, resolved hit

cases.title: Gravity Is Geometry
cases.source: Gravity is the curvature of spacetime caused by mass and energy. Objects follow the straightest available paths through that curved geometry, which we experience as falling or orbiting.
cases.evidence: Project 008 simulation from an upstream application-case source

scenes.vo: Gravity is not an invisible rope pulling objects across empty space. It is the shape of space and time around them. This changes everything nearby.
beats: A figure looks for an invisible pulling rope
A flat blue grid rises vertically behind the figure
The grid bends and sweeps upward into the lens
scenes.first_frame: a small object floats above an unmarked flat grid
scenes.final_frame: curved blue grid lines fill the frame
scenes.audio: curious pulse, soft pluck, elastic grid bend

scenes.vo: Mass and energy reshape that geometry, bending the routes available to objects and light moving nearby, without any visible contact.
beats: Inherited grid lines unwrap into a tall spacetime sheet
A red mass lowers into the sheet and changes its shape
Gold motion traces curve around the depression
scenes.first_frame: the same blue curves inherited from Scene 1
scenes.final_frame: one curved gold route exits downward
scenes.audio: low mass impact, fabric tension, passing particle tones

scenes.vo: An object in free fall is not fighting the curve. It follows the straightest path that curved spacetime allows, moment by moment.
beats: A white object inherits the descending gold route
The camera rotates around the sheet while the local route remains straight
The route curls into a circular viewing frame
scenes.first_frame: a gold route descends from the previous scene
scenes.final_frame: the route becomes a circular frame around Earth
scenes.audio: steady glide, camera orbit whoosh, soft lock tone

scenes.vo: Close to Earth, those straightest paths turn toward the ground, so a released object appears to accelerate downward along the curved route.
beats: Earth rises inside the inherited circular frame
A released white object follows stacked blue curves downward
The accelerating object crosses the lens as a wipe
scenes.first_frame: Earth sits inside the same circular route
scenes.final_frame: the falling object fills the lower foreground
scenes.audio: airy descent, accelerating ticks, close foreground pass

scenes.vo: Add enough sideways motion and the object keeps falling while continually missing Earth. That continuous fall is what we experience as orbit around the planet.
beats: The inherited object gains a sideways gold impulse
Its falling path repeatedly curves past Earth
The trail closes into one gold orbital ring
scenes.first_frame: the same object exits the foreground sideways
scenes.final_frame: a gold ring surrounds the blue Earth
scenes.audio: side impulse, looping orbit tone, harmonic lift

scenes.vo: The scale changes, but the mechanism remains the same: nearby mass curves geometry, and moving objects follow the paths that geometry makes available, from falling to orbiting.
beats: The inherited ring scales from object to planet system
Multiple curves share the same visual rule without labels
The camera pulls back to one clean curved grid and figure
scenes.first_frame: the orbital ring continues from Scene 5
scenes.final_frame: one blue grid curve returns to the opening composition
scenes.audio: expanding harmonics, linked orbit tones, calm resolved pulse

cases.title: From Voice Memo to Next Action
cases.title_zh: 从语音备忘到下一步行动
cases.source: A notes app that turns messy voice memos into clear tasks.
cases.evidence: Project 008 simulation from an upstream application-case source

scenes.vo: Ideas rarely arrive as tidy checklists. They show up while you are walking, commuting, or switching between a dozen unfinished thoughts.
beats: A centered figure juggles icon-only thought fragments
The fragments orbit faster in a compact square
One blue microphone icon catches the fragments
scenes.first_frame: a centered figure holds one loose thought dot
scenes.final_frame: a blue microphone circle fills the frame
scenes.audio: walking rhythm, thought pops, soft recording chime

scenes.vo: You record a voice memo to capture the moment, but later it becomes another long audio file you still need to review.
beats: The inherited microphone becomes a long blue waveform
Waveform capsules stack around the centered figure
The stack closes into a dense square tile
scenes.first_frame: the same blue microphone circle continues
scenes.final_frame: a dense waveform tile fills the center
scenes.audio: recording hiss, layered waveform pulses, muted stack impact

scenes.vo: The product idea is simple: give the memo to the app, then let it turn spoken fragments into clear task candidates.
beats: The waveform tile enters an icon-only app frame
Blue fragments separate into short gold cards
Cards settle into a compact central stack
scenes.first_frame: the waveform tile matches the previous square
scenes.final_frame: three gold task cards align vertically
scenes.audio: clean transform, card snaps, restrained reveal chord

scenes.vo: Instead of treating every fragment as certain, the experience can place each suggested task in front of you for review.
beats: The inherited cards expand one at a time
A figure compares, keeps, or returns icon-only candidates
Approved cards gain green check circles
scenes.first_frame: the same three gold cards remain centered
scenes.final_frame: one green check circle grows toward the lens
scenes.audio: card shuffle, selection ticks, one confident confirmation tone

scenes.vo: The value is not more notes. It is a shorter distance between saying what matters and seeing the next action you meant to take.
beats: The inherited check circle becomes a short gold path
A microphone and task card connect across the center
The figure steps onto the compact path
scenes.first_frame: the green check circle continues from Scene 4
scenes.final_frame: one raised foot pauses above the gold path
scenes.audio: path draw, connection pulse, held step tone

scenes.vo: Capture the thought in your own voice, review the tasks it produces, and move forward without leaving the idea buried in an audio file.
beats: The inherited foot lands on the gold path
Blue voice waves transform into checked task cards
The centered composition opens into clean square negative space
scenes.first_frame: the raised foot matches the same central path
scenes.final_frame: a microphone-to-task loop holds around the figure
scenes.audio: step impact, voice-to-card transformation, light resolved chord
